palette_child_interpretation: C17 uses a direct pixel affine inverse when identifiable. N13 instead decodes categorical codewords densely; N14/N15 use occupied24-bin colour averages and a coarse prior under their stated alternative forward models. These are complete implementations, not isolated loss ablations.
